official_sources.title: GDAL geotransform pixel/line coordinate convention
official_sources.finding: GDAL defines a six-coefficient affine mapping from pixel/line space to georeferenced coordinates; raster coordinates run from the upper-left corner at (0,0), and the upper-left pixel centre is at (0.5,0.5).
official_sources.limitation: The affine coefficients locate cells but do not decide whether a stored elevation represents a cell area or a point sample.

official_sources.title: GDAL AREA_OR_POINT raster sampling semantics
official_sources.finding: GDAL defines AREA_OR_POINT as Area by default or Point, distinguishing a value sampled over the pixel region from a point sample at the pixel centre while retaining area-oriented georeferencing.
official_sources.limitation: AREA_OR_POINT can be missing or incorrect and must be reconciled with the official product specification.

official_sources.title: GDAL GeoTIFF PixelIsPoint half-pixel interpretation
official_sources.finding: GDAL documents that RasterPixelIsPoint and historical compatibility handling can shift apparent GeoTIFF georeferencing by half a pixel.
official_sources.limitation: Legacy files or non-default compatibility settings require driver/version/configuration provenance before accepting cell indices.

official_sources.title: GDAL RasterIO window and buffer-size behavior
official_sources.finding: GDAL RasterIO uses x/y offsets and sizes for the source window; differing output-buffer dimensions invoke up/down-sampling and may use overviews, while equal dimensions read at full window resolution.
official_sources.limitation: A successful read is not proof that the requested indices were correct, and implicit data-type conversion can still alter values.

official_sources.title: Rasterio row/column and pixel centre/corner transforms
official_sources.finding: Rasterio index/rowcol converts fractional pixel coordinates with numpy.floor by default, while xy returns the pixel centre by default and can explicitly return ul, ur, ll or lr corners.
official_sources.limitation: Default floor behavior must not be silently replaced by round or ceil, especially on exact cell boundaries.

official_sources.title: Rasterio window rounding, cropping and half-open index conversion
official_sources.finding: Rasterio windows may have floating offsets and lengths; offset rounding uses the preceding integer, length rounding is separate, crop limits windows to dataset dimensions, and window_index rounds starts down and stops up.
official_sources.limitation: Generic rounding helpers can change coverage if applied in the wrong order; the unrounded window must remain in provenance.

official_sources.title: Rasterio geometry-derived outer pixel window
official_sources.finding: geometry_window requires shapes in the dataset CRS, returns the outermost containing pixel indices using floor offsets and ceiling width/height, raises WindowError when there is no overlap, and exposes padding and boundless controls.
official_sources.limitation: The candidate window only bounds the geometry; an exact geometry mask is still required to choose accepted cells.

official_sources.title: GDAL affine transform inversion success contract
official_sources.finding: GDAL exposes inversion of a geotransform from georeferenced coordinates to pixel/line coordinates and returns false when the affine equation is not invertible.
official_sources.limitation: Invertibility does not guarantee a well-conditioned transform; round-trip residuals and coefficient finiteness must also be checked.
